newsitem.title: USA: Corp debt players eye U.S. data after issue flood.
newsitem.headline: Corp debt players eye U.S. data after issue flood.

text.p: Fears that a strong batch of U.S. economic indicators due out next week might prompt another Federal Reserve tightening triggered players to get business squared away this week, dealers said.
"We have a plethora of economic data next week," said one high-grade source. "People were looking to square away business before that."

The corporate bond primary market saw $4.0 billion in new debt issuance alone on Thursday bringing the total for straight issuance to about $6.0 for the week. Still, two large debt offerings totaling about $6 billion remain to be priced.
Among next week's closely watched U.S. economic reports are new home sales, durable goods, employment cost index, consumer confidence, NAPM, first quarter GDP and nonfarm payrolls/unemployment.
After last month's one quarter point hike in the overnight lending rate by the Federal Open Market Committee, players will be eyeing next week's batch of data ahead of the Fed meeting on May 20.
Meanwhile, Thursday's supply of new issues featured a $1.7 billion multi-tranche debt offering from Comcast Corp unit Comcast Cable Communications.
